reviewItem.question: Does "Make sure you are not using any `v1alpha1` resources across all of your infrastructure" mean a change to migration:external-secrets|name=remove-v1alpha1-resources (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: The 0.16 upgrade guide lists a pre-upgrade check: before upgrading, operators must confirm that no `v1alpha1` resources are used anywhere in their infrastructure (manifests, tooling, etc.).
